messages:
maya (pm): ACME wants per-route budgets + auto-route-to-quantized variants for cost control; asking for a pilot asap.

sam (sales): they called it a renewal blocker.

tj (eng): we need a tenant policy table, cap enforcement, and billing telemetry. API-first MVP seems quickest.

anika (infra): note: per-tenant routing will increase cache fragmentation. expect perf impact unless we shard KV or relax keys.

maya (pm): plan: manual-config pilot this week (we apply rules), API pilot next week. fallback to default variant on cap hit.

oliver (design): ill prepare a one-page config snippet.

tj (eng): estimate: 3d spike + 2d tests + 1d runbook. feature-flagged pilot, single tenant, 2-week observation.

sam (sales): ACME wants EOW. manual pilot okay?

maya (pm): yes - propose we set rules for them and share the template. acceptance: config applied, cap usage visible, rollback documented, SLOs unaffected.

tj (eng): i'll open the PR and tag people. marking prio:urgent.

maya (pm): if pilot signals positive we scope UI + billing automation in Q3. thanks.
